class.name: PlayerMove
class.description: This class checks input every render frame and applies forces to a child [RigidBody3D] stored in [param RigidBody] every physics step, turning the [RigidBody3D] to face the input direction.

members.member: A reference to the [RigidBody3D] we want to control. Stored internally as an ObjectID. Should be a child of this Node.
The maximum speed the [RigidBody3D] can move at. The body may never actually reach this speed due to friction and damping etc.
The acceleration applied to the body when moving.
The speed at which the [RigidBody3D] turns to face the movement direction in radians per second.
The speed at which the [RigidBody3D] moves up and down. The Y height is limited to greater than -6 and less than 6.

return.description: The Class checks input from various InputActions listed below, and sums their strength to get a [Vector2] of movement direcions with the [code]x[/code] and [code]y[/code] elements corresponding to the x and z axis respectively. Left (X-) Right (X+) Forward (Z-) Backward (Z+) Upward (Y+) Downward (Y-)

Once per physics step, the Class calculates the force applied to the body by [param Moving Acceleration] in each direction supplied by [method _process]. If this is greater than zero (i.e we are trying to move), the Class then rotates the body to face the movement direction supplied by [method _process] at a rate of [param Turning Speed] radians per second.
